title: Correlation of Cardiac Output Determined by Echocardiography and Indirect Calorimetry in Critically Ill Patients in Cardiogenic Shock on Extracorporeal Circulatory Life Support
official: Correlation of Cardiac Output Determined by Echocardiography and Indirect Calorimetry in Critically Ill Patients in Cardiogenic Shock on Extracorporeal Circulatory Life Support
summary: This observational study investigates whether the daily measured trend of cardiac output as evaluated by indirect calorimetry correlates with the same evaluated by transthoracic echocardiography.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients that received cardiac surgery
2. Perioperative requirement of extracorporeal life support (ECLS)
3. Age ≥ 18 years
4. Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
2. Relationship or dependency with the study sponsor
3. Expected survival less than 72 hours after screening
